usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no extracted content — only identity anchors and retained sources. A reader learns who Michelle Gass is at a headline level (Kohl's ex-CEO, Levi Strauss & Co. CEO since 2024, Starbucks background) but nothing about her actions, accomplishments, or working style. Since nothing is asserted beyond the anchors, there is no false implication of completeness, though the dossier also never explicitly flags what is missing. It is not sufficient to prepare for a substantive meeting; one would need basic biographical and career detail. The three known unjustified conclusions (stale Kohl's CEO claim, sole Frappuccino credit, chemical-engineer inference) are catalogued as risks but none appear as claims in an empty dossier, so no overclaim findings with verbatim excerpts are possible.
